title: Watch This Ridiculous 70-person Super Mario 64 Relay
description: This year marks the 30th anniversary of Super Mario 64, a game that was designed to be a single-player showcase for the Nintendo 64. This title may not have been built with multiplayer in mind, but at this year's Awesome Games Done Quick (AGDQ) charity livestream, players turned Super Mario 64 into a team sport as 70 different speedrunners joined forces for a single 70-star run through the game. It was clear pretty early on that all of the speedrunners knew the tricks to getting Super Mario 64's stars in as little time as possible. Under their collective control, Mario pulled off some of the most athletic moves we've seen from Nintendo's iconic plumber. They even made some of the game's trickiest platforming moments seem easy. In total, this speed run lasted just under two hours. There are 120 stars in the game, so it's possible to pull off an even larger Super Mario 64 relay at future AGDQ events. The current AGDQ event also had a Mario Kart World speedrunner complete the All ? Panels category in under 30 minutes. Continue Reading at GameSpot

description: Ubisoft's The Division series celebrates its 10th anniversary this year, and the franchise has multiple games in the works right now, including The Division 3. The game was announced with little fanfare back in 2023, but more details have emerged since then. In this post, we're rounding up everything we know about the next entry in Ubisoft's popular online shooter series. Table of Contents [hide]When will The Division 3 be released? When will The Division 3 be released? Ubisoft has not announced a release date for The Division, or even a year. This information should come into focus in due course, but it remains to be seen when that could happen. Ubisoft announced The Division 3 back in 2023. At the time, the company said it was "actively building a team" for the game, suggesting the announcement might have been more of an effort to recruit staff. Companies are known to announce games early on with little detail in an effort to encourage people to come work for the company. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: The Sims Project Rene Has Shifted Into A Mobile Multiplayer Game
description: The next game in The Sims franchise--codenamed Project Rene--has turned into a mobile-first experience that's all about social multiplayer. It is not The Sims 5, and developer Maxis states this title can live in harmony with The Sims 4 and any future single-player installments in the series. EA and Maxis discussed the future of The Sims in a blog post celebrating the new year. Within this article, the companies noted that "Project Rene has evolved to focus on social multiplayer play, offering a more direct way for friends to share creativity together." In addition, the "mobile-first life-sim game" is about collaboration. However, The Sims franchise won't forget about its roots. The blog post states: "At its core, The Sims was built on a deep, single-player life simulation, chock full of rich systems, meaningful storytelling, and player agency that puts you in control. That foundation isn't going anywhere." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Three Pokemon Lego Sets Release Next Month, And Preorders Are Live
description: Pokemon Lego Sets Check out the February 27 launch lineup. Preorder at Lego Store Lego has unveiled three Pokemon building sets themed around Kanto region legends from Generation 1. All three models are part of Lego's display series for collectors and experienced builders. Preorders are available now ahead of Lego Pokemon's debut February 27. The most affordable model in the lineup is a 587-piece posable Eevee figure for $60. From there, the price jumps to $200 for Pikachu and Poke Ball, a 2,050-piece dynamic model with a buildable lightning bolt stand. For Pokemon fans with disposable income, check out the massive 6,836-piece Venusaur, Charizard, and Blastoise diorama. Priced at $650, the model comes with three large buildable figures and a modular stand themed around each Pokemon. If you preorder the Venusaur, Charizard, and Blastoise Lego set, you'll get an exclusive freebie while supplies last: the Kanto Region Badge Collection. The 312-piece set includes replicas of the eight badges from Pokemon Red/Blue inside a clamshell case. Lego Insiders will also have the chance to get a 233-piece Mini Pokemon Center at launch. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: This Xbox Game Just Passed $300 Million In Revenue On PS5, Report Says
description: Microsoft's Forza Horizon 5 continues to be a huge hit on PlayStation, it seems. Research from Alinea Analytics claims that the game just recently passed 5 million copies sold on PS5. This works out to more than $300 million in revenue on PS5 alone for the 2021 game. Alinea's Rhys Elliott said this data proves why Microsoft is keen to release more of its own games on a rival platform like Sony's PS5. "Xbox's move to third-party is no mystery, especially given Microsoft's lofty profitability mandates," Elliott said. As Microsoft does not keep 100% of the revenue, as Sony gets a cut for its platform fee. The industry standard revenue share is 70/30. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Five-Year-Old Survival Game Icarus Just Sold Nearly 1 Million Copies In Three Weeks
description: Steam sales are always a great opportunity to pick up some bargains, and the recent Steam Winter Sale, which ran from December 18, 2025 until January 5, 2026, was no exception. While many games typically see a spike in sales and players during these periods, one multiplayer game saw a particularly huge surge in sales following an enormous discount. Icarus, a PvE survival game from New Zealand studio RocketWerkz that was first released in December 2021, was reduced from its usual $35 price to a mere $3.50 during the Steam Winter Sale - an enormous 90% saving. Now, RocketWerkz founder Dean Hall has revealed just how many copies of Icarus were sold during the sale. In a post on X, Hall shared that that an enormous 984,000 copies were during this sales period. On top of that, the game's DLC, which includes two expansions and a "pets" bundle, moved a further 243,000 units. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Divinity Team Says Character Creation Will Be "Even Better" Than Baldur’s Gate 3
description: Baldur's Gate 3 was the kind of game that could take hours to get started, thanks in part to a rich character customization suite that allowed players to fine-tune everything from their race to several minute details. For the upcoming Divinity, developer Larian Studios says that players can expect "even better" options for fine-tuning their character when the game eventually launches. "We are planning to have an even better one! More colors, more options, more control," Divinity art director Alena Dubrovina wrote in a Reddit AMA session. That's a high bar for the studio to set, considering just how detailed the Baldur's Gate 3 character customization system is. Beyond the standard options, players can also tinker with unique biological traits depending on the race they choose, fiddle around with facial features, and much more. Just when you think you've got your character nailed down, the game also offers you a chance to design a Spirit Guardian for your adventurer, a character who will appear in your dreams. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Palworld Is Making A Play For The Trading Card Crowd Later This Year
description: Palworld: Official Card Game, a brand-new trading card game based on Pocketpair's creature-collecting game, has been revealed by Bushiroad and developer Pocketpair. While details are light for now, the game already has a launch date penciled in for July 30. Bushiroad describes Palworld: Official Card Game as a two-player competitive card game where players can "enjoy strategic and tactical battles" by deploying unique Pals to the battlefield. "Players fight alongside their Pal companions, gathering resources, and building bases as they aim for victory," the description reads. Each Pal also has unique traits, and cleverly utilizing them can open up a path to victory. Rumblings of a Palworld trading card game kicked off last year after Pocketpair and Animate subsidiary COS purchased shares in Japanese card game publisher Bushiroad. Bushiroad Corporation's CEO and president, Takaaki Kidani, sold his shares to the company (via Automaton). This followed Pocketpair's formation of Palworld Entertainment, a new company arm dedicated to maximizing Palworld's merchandising opportunities. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Download The Hytale Launcher Now, As Hypixel Estimates "Over 1 Million" Players At Launch
description: Hytale has been on quite a development journey. After being acquired and subsequently shuttered by Riot Games, the original development team bought the Minecraft rival back and recommenced development in November 2025. On January 13, the title goes into early access, which the team acknowledges will be unpolished and full of bugs. Still, Hypixel--the developer behind one of the most popular Minecraft servers of all time--is expecting mammoth launch-day numbers, estimating "over 1 million" players. To that end, the studio is encouraging users to download the game's launcher ahead of time in order. Hypixel's CEO, Simon Collins-Laflamme, posted on X stating, "We expect over 1 million players on the early access release day for Hytale ... Please download the launcher today and log in now to help us significantly reduce launch-day stress." Hypixel's preorders have been open since early December, so the team has had around a month to gauge interest, meaning this player estimate is based on those figures and not just speculation. Hypixel has already allowed mod creators early access to the game so they can research and develop the best Hytale mods for the early access release. Modders are adding new game modes, cosmetics, items, and quality-of-life improvements to the game, with more being added daily. When the game launches tomorrow, January 13, all of those mods will be available via Curseforge thanks to an agreement between the modding platform and Hypixel Studios. Continue Reading at GameSpot
